title: VISTA: A Framework for Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness
abstract: arXiv:2611.20458v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming intelligent transportation systems by connecting roadside cameras, edge computing units, vehicles, and traffic infrastructure into a shared sensing and decision-making ecosystem. However, transmitting raw traffic video over vehicle-to-everything (V2X) links is bandwidth-intensive, while deploying large multimodal models directly on resource-constrained vehicles is often impractical. To address these limitations, this article proposes VISTA (Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness), a multimodal vision-language edge-intelligence framework that combines predictive video representation learning with lightweight language-based reasoning to provide communication-efficient traffic situational awareness. translated_title: VISTA：一个视觉驱动的语义交通感知框架
translated_abstract: 物联网正在变革智能交通系统，它将路边摄像头、边缘计算单元、车辆和交通基础设施连接成一个共享的感知与决策生态系统。然而，通过车联网（V2X）链路传输原始交通视频需要占用大量带宽，而直接在资源受限的车辆上部署大型多模态模型往往不切实际。为解决这些局限，本文提出了VISTA（视觉驱动的语义交通感知），一个多模态视觉-语言边缘智能框架，它将预测性视频表示学习与轻量级的基于语言的推理相结合，以提供通信高效的交通态势感知。在所提出的架构中，路边监控单元采用视频联合嵌入预测架构（V-JEPA）和注意力池化模块，将交通视频片段转换为紧凑的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出VISTA多模态视觉-语言边缘智能框架，通过在路边设备上用V-JEPA进行预测性视频表示学习并结合轻量级语言推理，以语义形式替代原始视频传输，从而实现V2X网络下通信高效的交通态势感知。
en_tdlr: VISTA is a multimodal vision-language edge-intelligence framework that combines V-JEPA-based predictive video representation learning at roadside units with lightweight language-based reasoning, enabling communication-efficient semantic traffic awareness over V2X networks instead of bandwidth-intensive raw video transmission.
